title: SYNTHLA-EDU V2 — Synthetic Educational Data Benchmark
summary: A privacy-aware benchmark comparing synthetic data generators (SDV's Gaussian Copula and CTGAN, plus Synthcity's TabDDPM) on educational datasets (OULAD and ASSISTments), evaluating quality, utility, realism, and privacy leakage. SDV's single-table API (GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata) is directly instantiated and fit to generate two of the three synthesizer outputs, and sdmetrics' QualityReport is called to score them.
